title: NATIONAL BANKSHARES INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: National Bankshares Inc (NKSH), a small regional bank headquartered in Blacksburg, Virginia, filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its bylaws effective May 13, 2026, reducing the board of directors from 13 to 12 members due to the retirement of director Charles E. Green, III under the age limit provision. The filing confirms Mr. Green's retirement is not related to any disagreement on company operations, policies, or practices.
